messages:
Maria (PM): Quick sync request 1: Vertica pilot asking Dedicated GA SLA=99.99%. Need short triage: engineering, ops, docs, and commercial impacts. @Ajay @Sam @Lina @Jordan

Ajay (Eng): Flag: current Dedicated SLO=99.9%. Moving to 99.99% cuts error budget ~10x. Major engineering gaps: cold-starts, KV-cache warmup tail, and host preemption handling. Will list mitigations.

Sam (SRE): Ops implications: pre-warmed hot pools, cross-region control-plane failover, and faster automated failover. We should tighten paging: propose page only when `service_error_rate > 0.1% for 10m` else warn. Also need 48h staging burn-in under GA load.

Ajay (Eng): Mitigations (high level): 1) persistent hot allocs for top models, 2) KV priming on deploy, 3) model-variant fallback flow (quantized-high -> quantized-low -> compact), 4) faster eviction policy. I'll draft RFC with perf deltas and timelines.

Lina (Support): Docs needed: external SLA doc (credits calc), incident-to-credit timeline, escalation ladder, canned customer comms for fallback or capacity events. Can produce first drafts by Wed EOD.

Jordan (FinOps): Commercial: premium SLA must be a higher-priced tier + reservation commit. Suggest pricing multiplier ~1.7-2x and minimum monthly commit. Also include storage uplift for longer observability retention (90d vs 30d). I'll run unit-econ sims.

Maria (PM): Owners: Ajay=RFC+fallback, Sam=runbooks+alerts, Lina=customer docs+templates, Jordan=pricing sims + contract language. Internal sign-off next Tue; external reply Thu. Ack?

Ajay (Eng): Ack. Will include cost/latency table for fallback variants.

Sam (SRE): Ack. I'll add SLO burn policy and oncall impact (2-3 SREs for 3w infra work).

Lina (Support): Ack. I'll draft short customer notification templates and KB.

Jordan (FinOps): Ack. Will include reserve/throughput modeling + trace retention cost.

deploy-bot: preflight smoke passed at 1799999000: `smoke: ok` :white_check_mark:

Maria (PM): One more: observability retention for premium SLA = 90d traces/logs; confirm storage estimate included in pricing. Also decide whether premium gets dedicated crash-only pools or shared with prioritization. Ajay/Sam thoughts?

Ajay (Eng): Prefer shared with priority routing (less ops overhead). If customer needs isolation, that's a different product (Dedicated private lane). I'll note both options with cost delta.

Sam (SRE): Agreed. Add staging failover test and automated rollback criteria to runbook.

Maria (PM): Great. Meeting Mon 10am PT for pre-signoff. If you can't make it, drop notes here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
